messages.subject: Re: Mathematical symbols in legends
parts:
Hi:

Here is a toy example:

DF <- data.frame(age = rpois(40, 55), y = rnorm(40, 10))
DF$Age <- cut(DF$age, c(0, 60, 200), labels = c("< 60", "60+"),
include.lowest = TRUE)

# Set up legend labels with mathematical symbols
labs <- list(expression(Age < 60), expression(Age >= 60))

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(DF, aes(x = age, y = y, color = Age)) +
geom_point() +
scale_color_manual(breaks = levels(DF$Age),
values = c("red", "blue"),
labels = labs)

Dennis
